iśeṣa īśvaraḥ / Kaivalyaṃ prāptās tarhi santi ca
641
bahavaḥ kevalinaḥ, te hi trīṇi bandhanāni cchittvā kaivalyaṃ prāptāḥ / Īśvarasya ca
642 tat-
saṃbandho na bhūto na bhāvī / Yathā muktasya pūrvā bandha-koṭiḥ prajñāyate, na–evam
īśvarasya / Yathā
643 vā prakṛti-līnasya–uttarā bandha-koṭiḥ saṃbhāvyate, na–evam īśvarasya
/ Sa tu sadā–eva muktaḥ sadā–eva–īśvara iti /
Yo'sau prakṛṣṭa-sattva-upādānād īśvarasya śāśvatika utkarṣaḥ sa kiṃ sa-nimitta āhosvin nir-
nimitta iti ? Tasya śāstraṃ nimittam / Śāstraṃ punaḥ kiṃ nimittam ? Prakṛṣṭa-sattva-
nimittam / Etayoḥ śāstra-utkarṣayor īśvara-sattve vartamānayor anādiḥ saṃbandhaḥ /
Etasmād etad bhavati
644 / Sadā–eva
